title: PrismStudio 1.2.0 — it stopped fighting you
notes: Opening a file is about twenty times quicker: it was forking a git process for every cursor movement, hundreds per file.
Typing in a large file no longer drags, and the first Python file you open no longer freezes the window while a language server starts.
Claude floats over the editor now — Ctrl+Shift+C to bring it up, Escape to dismiss, and nothing else on screen moves. Dock it in the panel, beside the editor or in its own window if you prefer.
Ctrl+Tab goes back to the file you were just in, not the next tab along.
Every file carries a tinted tile with its extension, in the tree and on its tab, and the start page tells you what you had open last.
